annotations.title: Use a formula as an accord

description: Use this when the user wants to use one of their saved formulas as a single ingredient inside another, as the app's accords do: a virtual material carrying the flattened composition (so IFRA, allergens, cost and the scent profile see what is inside) on a bottle at the accord's own aromatic strength. Optionally at an amount in grams.

formula.description: The formula that receives the accord: its id or exact name.

source.description: The formula to use as the accord: its id or exact name.
